mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment rate above 4.5% indicates labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in 60% or more of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales (HOUST and RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenue expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rapid growth in industrial production above 1.5% year-over-year signals robust supply chain activity and corporate capacity utilization, which supports higher earnings and predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 1.5% yoy, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 1550.0 thousand units indicates strong residential construction activity, which correlates with elevated consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when HOUST exceeds 1550.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in employment and decline in unemployment signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production above its 200-day moving average indicates expanding manufacturing output, which supports corporate earnings growth and predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when INDPRO is above its 200-day moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the Federal Reserve's rate hikes compress equity valuations through higher discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in 60% or more of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.
